facts.text: As Wisconsin's polytechnic university, UW-Stout provides three times as many labs and studios as traditional classrooms and connects students with paid co-ops.

sources.title: Our Polytechnic Advantage | UW-Stout Polytechnic
sources.quote: Unlike other four-year universities, UW-Stout Polytechnic has 3x the labs and studios as traditional classrooms, so you'll spend more time applying your knowledge and skills in actual industry-aligned environments, doing undergraduate research, and in paid co-ops
